title: Measuring Political Stance and Consistency in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to 24 politically sensitive geopolitical and social issues using various prompting strategies (direct questions, providing opposite arguments, providing both sides, and reformulating questions), followed by using a secondary LLM judge to classify the models' adopted political stances.

Translating prompts about regional geopolitical disputes into the local languages of the involved countries (e.g., Turkish vs. Greek, Russian vs. Ukrainian) to measure if the language of the prompt influences the model to adopt a stance favoring the corresponding side.
